attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Oregon state income tax (2025). Simplified top-marginal-rate implementation per ORS § 316.037: tax = max(AGI - filing-status std ded, 0) x 9.9%. Standard deductions: $2,745 Single/MFS, $5,495 MFJ/QSS, $4,415 HOH. Real brackets are a follow-up. Writes result.computed_state_tax and result.computed_state_taxable_income.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.computed_state_tax = 0; set result.computed_state_taxable_income = 0; add " Oregon Tax Calculation (top marginal 9.9%)" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef " Oregon Tax Calculation (top marginal 9.9%)" job.audit_trail swap addto
initial_action.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.computed_state_tax xdef 0.0 /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef " Oregon Tax Calculation (top marginal 9.9%)" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly or Qualifying Surviving Spouse
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ" or job.filing_status is equal to "QSS"
condition_details.condition_postfix: job.filing_status "MFJ" streq { pop job.filing_status "QSS" streq } over not if

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 5495.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.099
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 5495.0 - 0.0 fmax cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.099 fmul cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 4415.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.099
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 4415.0 - 0.0 fmax cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.099 fmul cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 2745.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.099
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 2745.0 - 0.0 fmax cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.099 fmul cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

policy_statement.policy_description: OR MFJ: 9.9% x max(AGI - $5,495, 0) per ORS § 316.037
OR HOH: 9.9% x max(AGI - $4,415, 0) per ORS § 316.037
OR Single/MFS: 9.9% x max(AGI - $2,745, 0) per ORS § 316.037
